shot_purpose: 展示 deltoid 为什么能带着单位线段完成所有方向，并解释方向不会漏。

mathematical_locks: Deltoid must be a true three-cusped hypocycloid-style region; show unit chord scale with a = 1/4 and area A = pi/8; never use radius 1/3 as the unit-needle scale.

continuity.in: 从 SH006 deltoid 闭合处直接推入。
continuity.out: 切到标尺和公式锁定弦长。
